title: Evaru Cheyagalarayya – Kenny Chaitanya Telugu Christian Lyrics
telugu: నీ ప్రేమకై స్తోత్రము నీ కృపకై వందనము
నిన్ను ద్వేషించిన వాడనయ్యా నీ దయను కోల్పోతినయ్యా
అయిన నన్ను క్షమియించినావు కృపలోగిలిలో నన్ను దాచినావు
వెలిగించుమా దివ్య జ్యోతిగా నడిపించుమా నీ సేవలో
శిల్పకారుడా నన్ను చెక్కుము నీ రూపముకే వచ్చేవరకు
english: Nee premakai sthothramu nee krupakai vandhanamu
Ninnu dveshinchina vaadanayya nee dhayanu kolpothinayya
Ayina nannu kshaminchinaavu krupaloo needaloo nanu dhachinaavu
Veliginchuma dhivya jyothiga nadipinchuma nee sevalo
Shilpakaruda nannu chekkumu nee roopamu vacche varaku
translation: Who can make a sacrifice like Yours, Lord?
Who can show love like Yours, Lord?
Praise for Your love, thanks for Your grace
1. I was one who insulted You, I drifted far away from You
I was one who hated You, I lost Your favor
Yet You forgave me and hid me in the shadow of Your grace
2. While I was in sin, surrounded by darkness
You enlightened me with the light of Your Word, Jesus
Light me up as a divine flame, lead me in Your service
3. Though I was like a broken vessel (clay pot), You did not despise or throw me away
Though I was useless, You called me to Your ministry
O Sculptor, mold me until Your image appears in me
Until Your likeness is formed within me
intro: Evaru Cheyagalarayya is the latest Telugu Christian song, sung by Kalpana Raghavendar and music composed by Kenny Chaitanya. This song was released on April 12, 2026, through Emmanuel Ministries Hyderabad YouTube Channel.
